resources.string: Connect to the access desk on your computer

The Python server must be running on your computer. On the same Wi-Fi, start it with --allow-lan and enter the LAN address printed in the terminal, for example http://192.168.x.x:8765.

Over USB, keep the default loopback server and run adb reverse tcp:8765 tcp:8765, then enter http://127.0.0.1:8765.

Paste the owner unlock key from the terminal after the HUD opens. Do not use this on public Wi-Fi.

Jarvis Companion can open apps, tap, type, scroll, go back or home, and read text on the screen only after you approve each action on a card (and, for risky actions, after you say Confirm). It does not type or read in the background. You can turn this service off at any time, and the in-app kill switch immediately stops all actions. This is a personal, sideloaded assistant; Google Play does not allow general phone-control accessibility services.
The optional notification listener only runs after you enable it in Android settings, and reading notifications still requires your approval each time.
